author: TurnipTheTiger
body:
I did this in under 2 minutes :P



Yes, I know it was a long time ago when my name was randjminecraft but Senex is still the same map ^.^

My Tactic:

I ninja bridged to the middle then waited for the other team to finish their bridge. Then when everyone was looting the chests with the chainmail armour and flame bow, I rushed along their bridged then stacked up to the top of the spawn. A few people were getting iron armour but I made sure they didn't see me. Then ninja bridged over to the monument (no one was chasing me) then built a bridge between the 2 mons. Then just broke them both :P

Time: Under 1:30 (you can still see the timer to countdown the seconds before it starts lol)
